overview.description: The Northern Trust Tax-Exempt Bond ETF (TAXT) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in investment grade fixed income. The fund tracks a market value-weighted index of US investment grade municipal bonds with varying maturities. Eligible debt securities must be exempt from US federal income taxes and the federal alternative minimum tax. TAXT was launched on Aug 18, 2025 and is issued by Northern Trust.
